name: McClellan-Palomar Airport

runway.v: one runway, 06/24, 4,897 ft x 150 ft (about 1,493 m x 46 m)

curfew.v: voluntary quiet hours only: jets 22:00-07:00, propeller aircraft 00:00-06:00 local (emergency, lifeguard and law enforcement excepted); the airport stays open 24 hours and no fines can be levied
curfew.quote: Jet take-off and landing "Quiet Hours" 10:00 p.m. – 7:00 a.m.

hours.v: airport open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year; when the tower is closed aircraft self-announce on CTAF
hours.quote: the airport must remain open 24 hours a day, 365 days of the year

noise.v: jets depart on a 250 degree ground track north of Palomar Airport Road at best rate of climb until 1 mile offshore; runway 24 is the calm-wind runway; no jet training
noise.quote: Jets fly 250 degrees ground track, north of Palomar Airport Road best rate of climb until 1 mile offshore.

customs.v: user-fee customs daily 09:00-17:00 Pacific; overtime service by appointment; user fee by maximum take-off weight (2026 regular USD 110 up to 7,500 lb to USD 2,180 over 75,000 lb; aircraft for 15 or more passengers USD 2,905)
customs.quote: McClellan-Palomar Airport offers regular User Fee Customs Service daily between the hours of 9 a.m. and 5 p.m.

notes: Runway from the FAA airport diagram for cycle 22 Jan-19 Feb 2026 (newest found); ft to m conversion mine. Customs, noise and hours from County of San Diego (airport operator) pages, undated. The customs page also shows '24-HOUR SERVICE AVAILABLE' without explanation; overtime needs an appointment. No airline service at CRQ (county FAQ). FAA Chart Supplement could not be opened.
